description: This file defines a ViewModel for the Home screen of an Android TV application, managing the UI state for multiple content categories, handling asynchronous data loading, and exposing state flows and convenience flags for UI binding.

classes.name: RailState
classes.description: Data class representing the UI state for a single content rail, including title, loading status, error message, and list of items.

classes.name: HomeViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel managing the loading and state of multiple content category rails on the Home screen, supporting parallel data fetch and state updates.

methods.name: loadAll
methods.description: Initiates loading of all category rails in parallel.

methods.name: loadCategory
methods.description: Internal method that fetches data for a given category and updates the state accordingly.
